values.headline: Heavy-Duty Truck Service & Repair in Longview, TX
values.subhead: Fast Turnaround. Certified Technicians. Built for Fleet Uptime.
values.body: At East Texas Mack, we provide complete truck service and repair solutions for fleets, municipalities, owner-operators, and over-the-road trucking operations across East Texas. Our operation is engineered around a single priority: keeping your trucks on the road and minimizing downtime. To keep your fleet moving, we back our shop with aggressive turnaround commitments, delivering scheduled preventative maintenance completed within the same day, rapid diagnostic evaluations for vehicles arriving before noon, and complex major engine repairs completed in as little as 24 hours depending on component availability. We also offer fully dispatched mobile repair support and customized fleet maintenance programs.

copy.text: Proper diagnostics, preventative scheduling, and high-standard repairs form the backbone of a resilient fleet strategy, preventing minor component fatigue from cascading into catastrophic failure on the highway.

Our certified facility services Mack trucks along with all heavy-duty commercial makes and models across demanding regional industries. We specialize in supporting high-duty-cycle operations, including refuse and waste management, heavy construction haulers, oilfield support fleets, municipal utility vehicles, and long-haul over-the-road trucking fleets. Our factory-trained technicians handle every tier of maintenance, ranging from routine fluid inspections, precision wheel alignments, advanced electronic troubleshooting, and engine overhauls to on-site mobile repair, custom fabrication, body shop repairs, and structured fleet maintenance support.

Structured preventative care is the most effective defense against unbudgeted roadside breakdowns and early component wear. Our comprehensive maintenance programs encompass routine oil and filter replacements, thorough brake and suspension geometry checks, precision wheel alignments, cooling system pressure testing, and advanced emissions monitoring.

When a vehicle arrives at our Longview shop before noon, our team initiates same-day diagnostic procedures utilizing factory-grade fault code analysis, advanced electronic diagnostics, and real-time system performance evaluation to deliver accurate, permanent fixes on the first visit.

Our specialized emissions services include Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) cleaning and forced regeneration, selective catalytic reduction (SCR) system diagnostics, Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF) quality testing, and sensor line repair, protecting full engine output and long-term fuel efficiency.

We handle complete engine rebuilds, high-pressure fuel system servicing, turbocharger assembly replacements, cooling system overhauls, and aftertreatment rebuilds, with typical turnarounds as fast as 24 hours on qualifying repairs.

Beyond mechanical repairs, our Longview facility features a full-service commercial body shop built to manage severe structural and cosmetic repairs. Equipped with two full-size paint booths and dedicated fabrication bays, our body shop specialists handle everything from cab alignment and structural frame repair to custom metal fabrication. We also provide specialized mounting capabilities for any commercial truck body, including dump bodies, roll-off systems, and custom vocational equipment.

When bringing a truck to our shop isn't practical, our fleet of mobile service units brings certified shop capabilities directly to your job site, yard, or roadside location. We operate two fully equipped mobile service trucks capable of handling emergency roadside repairs, scheduled fleet yard maintenance, and diagnostic troubleshooting. By completing the majority of repairs directly on-site without requiring transport back to the shop, we eliminate towing expenses and drastically cut operational disruption.

boxes.title: Fleet Maintenance & Uptime Solutions
boxes.text: We partner closely with commercial fleet operators to simplify long-term asset management through tailored support programs. Our services include full-service leasing plans, customized Mack Service Contracts, and priority service scheduling designed to streamline routine upkeep, flatten unexpected repair costs, and sustain high uptime across your entire roster of trucks.

copy.text: Our service bay is powered by highly trained master technicians holding specialized credentials, including Mack Master Technician certifications, Cummins Certified status, Allison Transmission certifications, and Mack Uptime Certified specialization.

cards.title: Largest Service Capacity in the Region

copy.text: 22 dedicated service bays and 6 specialized fabrication bays — one of the largest single-location commercial service operations in East Texas.
Approximately 80% of our daily customer volume serves commercial fleet operations across refuse, construction, oil and gas, municipal services, and over-the-road transportation.
